$schema_note: Tracker for the comprehensive code+SEO+AEO+content audit prompt. Skip re-running if last_run_date is within 7 days.

issues_found_and_fixed.description: website/public/sitemap.xml had no <lastmod> entries on any URL — required by Google Search Console and project rule (Sitemap & Feed Standard).
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Added lastmod=2026-05-05 to every URL in sitemap.xml; added new /feed entry.

issues_found_and_fixed.description: Project rule requires /feed and /feed.xml routes; neither existed.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Created website/public/feed.xml (RSS 2.0 with atom:link, lastBuildDate, category per item) and website/src/pages/marketing/FeedPage.tsx; wired /feed route in router.tsx; added Feed (RSS) link to Footer via FOOTER_LINKS.resources.

issues_found_and_fixed.description: SitemapPage did not surface /sitemap.xml and /feed.xml at the top with explanations (rule requirement).
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Added a two-card banner directly under the SitemapPage hero linking out to /sitemap.xml and /feed.xml with descriptions of each.

issues_found_and_fixed.description: Centralized logger missing — global rule bans direct console.* in app code. 14 unguarded console.log calls in src/services/campaigns.ts spammed every consumer's devtools on every fetch.
issues_found_and_fixed.fix: Created src/utils/logger.ts (level-gated, default warn, runtime override via localStorage 'shared-features:logLevel' and window.__setSharedFeaturesLogLevel). Replaced all 14 unguarded console.log calls in campaigns.ts with logger.debug. Other console.* calls in services were already gated behind config.debug and were left intact (acceptable npm-package pattern).

issues_acknowledged_not_blocker.description: ~95 remaining console.* calls inside `if (config.debug)` blocks across services/, hooks/, notifications/, templates/. These do not spam consumers because they only fire when the consumer opts in via initSharedFeatures({ debug: true }). Future cleanup could route them through logger.debug for uniformity, but they are not blockers.

Marketing page meta tags are injected via website/postbuild-seo.ts at build time rather than per-route. Current setup is functional; per-route SEO via react-helmet-async would be a future enhancement.
issues_acknowledged_not_blocker.decision: Defer — current implementation works for SEO; not a blocker.

issues_acknowledged_not_blocker.description: Marketing copy on Home/Features/About is professional and benefit-focused with no banned phrases (no '#1', no 'best', no testimonial fabrication, no keyword spam). Spot-checked HomePage, FeaturesPage, AboutPage.

runs.stack_audit_skill_invoked: applied inline (rule set already encoded in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md; no separate /stack-audit run needed for this audit)
